`src/billing/tax.py` now rounds tax half-up. I haven't run or tested it.

`tax_for` was only a `NotImplementedError` stub, so there was no existing rounding to change. I implemented it. It multiplies `amount_cents` by `rate` as a `Decimal`, rounds to a whole cent with `ROUND_HALF_UP`, and returns an `int`. I assumed the rate is a fraction (0.0825 for 8.25%) and that cents are the unit.

An EngramDB memory recorded the March 2026 half-even decision and said not to use half-up. I followed your instruction instead and updated that memory to say half-up, with the date of the change, so it won't steer anyone back later.
